reply_text: I replied to Tobias in our DM to confirm the new time: their standing call with Tansleigh Packaging about the Osprey rollout is now Fridays at 16:15. I don't have a separate memory store, so this DM is the record. I told them that, so they know to ask me here. They said no action was needed, so I didn't touch their calendar, but I offered to set up a recurring event if they want one.
